body.message:
Hi there,
I own a property in Business Bay currently rented long-term at AED 73,000 per year. I’m looking to convert it into a holiday home and wanted to understand how your setup works.

Do you handle everything including utilities, or are those still paid by the owner? Some other operators I’ve spoken to mentioned utilities are covered within their structure, so just wanted to understand how you handle it.

Also, how does your fee structure work and what kind of net return could I realistically expect after all costs?

Just trying to see if it makes sense compared to my current long-term rental.

Thanks 👍
